newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras PN upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Telebras PN upgraded.

text.p: -- Brazilian bank Icatu said it has maintained its outperformer/buy rating on common voting, or ordinary shares of Brazilian telecoms group Telebras but upgraded the firm's preferred share to buy from market performer/neutral.
-- "Diminishing telecom risks make us more confident," the bank said in a report.
-- "New cellular rules and the increasingly plausible 'spinoff' privatization model benefit Telebras," it added.
-- The bank also said it has lowered its 1996 earnings estimate for Telebras to 2.702 billion reais from 2.904 billion reais.
-- But it has raised its 1997 earnings forcast to 4.133 billion reais from 3.997 billion reais due to the impact of tariff adjustments expected to come in early 1997.
-- Icatu said Telebras posted a nine-month, non-inflation-adjusted earnings of 1.98 billion reais and an inflation-adjusted profit of 2.042 billion reais.

-- Telebras' third-quarter earnings of 638 million reais were down eight percent from the prior quarter due mainly to Telerj's voluntary dismissal program and an inventory write-off by long-distance unit Embratel, it said.
-- "Other similar provisions expeced to occur in the fourth quarter lead us to revise out 1996 earnings projections downward," the bank said.
-- The bank said a new round of tariff rebalancing in early 1997 will benefit Telebras and that strong plant growth and tight cost controls will more than offset reductions in some tariffs.
-- Telebras preferred ended at 79.40 reais while its voting common closed at 72.50 reais on Tuesday on the Sao Paulo bourse. Its ADR ended in New York at 76 3/8.
